# serde corpus `config`: one case per line, `<id> TAB ok|err TAB <answer>`.
# ok: the value written back out; err: the error's Display. \n \t \r \\ and
# \u{..} escape control characters; an ok longer than 4096 bytes is its
# FNV-1a digest and length. docs/AUDIT-third-party-2026-10-15.md, SP.3.
